proven by a URL-building test for a model with its own minimum year (Camry Hybrid 2018) and one using the scenario default (Prius 2019)\u0022,\u0022The carvana cvnaid JSON WalkSites builds carries \\u0022year\\u0022:{\\u0022min\\u0022:\\u003Cminimum model year\\u003E} and \\u0022mileage\\u0022:{\\u0022max\\u0022:\\u003Cmaximum mileage\\u003E} beside the existing makes and fuelTypes entries, encoded base64url without padding exactly as today; proven by a test that decodes the built cvnaid and compares the object, including the hybrid-only-from-2025 Camry case\u0022,\u0022The per-pair summary still reports drops by reason, and a walk against the recorded fixtures produces no \\u0027below minimum year\\u0027 or \\u0027over mileage\\u0027 exclusions for pages the search returned; proven by existing walk tests still passing plus one that asserts the facet values are read from the Scenario, not hard-coded\u0022,\u0022The README\\u0027s walk section and the run skill\\u0027s walk line name both facets; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-1f on 2026-09-23 (notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md, Gaps found): 18 of the 31 exclusions after walk run 3 were year or mileage, and all 12 Honda Insights the walk found were excluded, so the ranked list had no Insight. The facet parameters were verified live by the orchestrator over CDP in Brian\\u0027s Edge on 2026-09-24; the exact URLs, the decoded carvana JSON, and the observed effect are in the section \\u0027Year and mileage facet URLs, verified by the orchestrator\\u0027 at the end of notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md. Note the carvana key is the singular \\u0022year\\u0022 (a \\u0022years\\u0022 key is silently ignored) and \\u0022mileage\\u0022:{\\u0022max\\u0022:N}. The URL builders live in src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSites.cs (see BaseModelSlug and the cvnaid builder from PR #10 and PR #13 for the encoding). Minimum model year is per model in the scenario (2019 default, Camry 2018) and maximum mileage is the scenario\\u0027s filter value; read both from Scenario.
